ru.R: Я был в этом уверен, поэтому решил сначала побывать у вас. Тогда вы получили бы Божью благодать дважды, через два моих посещения. \v 16 Я собирался остановиться у вас по пути в Македонию. Потом я хотел вернуться к вам из Македонии, а вы помогли бы мне отправиться в Иудею.

uk.L: І з цією впевненістю я хотів спершу прийти до вас, щоб ви мали другу благодать, \v 16 і через вас пройти до Македонії, і знову з Македонії прийти до вас, і щоб ви провели мене до Юдеї.
uk.B: Будучи в цьому впевнений, я задумав спершу прийти до вас, щоб ви вдруге отримали дар благодаті. \v 16 Я мав пройти через ваше місто дорогою до Македонії, повернутися до вас із Македонії, а потім ви допомогли б мені вирушити до Юдеї.
uk.R: Я був у цьому впевнений, тому й задумав спочатку відвідати вас. Так ви отримали б Божу благодать двічі, через два мої приїзди. \v 16 Я планував зупинитися у вас дорогою до Македонії. Потім я повернувся б до вас із Македонії, і ви допомогли б мені вирушити в подорож до Юдеї.

ja.L: そして、この確信をもって、わたしはまず、あなたがたのところへ行こうと望んでいました。あなたがたが二度目の恵みを受けるためです。\v 16 そして、あなたがたのところを通ってマケドニア州へ行き、再びマケドニア州からあなたがたのところへ行き、あなたがたによってユダヤへ送り出してもらおうと[望んでいました]。
ja.B: このことを確信していたので、わたしはまず、あなたがたのところへ行こうと計画していました。あなたがたに二度目の恵みの贈り物を届けるためです。\v 16 あなたがたの町を通ってマケドニア州へ行き、マケドニア州から再びあなたがたのところへ戻り、それから、あなたがたにユダヤへの旅を助けてもらうつもりでした。
ja.R: わたしはこのことを確信していたので、まずみなさんを訪ねようと計画しました。わたしが二回訪ねれば、みなさんは神の恵みを二度受けることができます。\v 16 マケドニア州へ行く途中で、みなさんのところに寄るつもりでした。それから、マケドニア州からまたみなさんのところに戻り、みなさんにユダヤへの旅を助けてもらうつもりだったのです。

decisions.choice: a second gift of God's grace, brought through a second visit
alternatives: a second favor or kindness from Paul
a second chance to show kindness
decisions.reason: χάριν here is not God's grace in the general sense but a particular benefit of it: Paul's visits bring God's gifts (Romans 1:11; 15:29). The plan was to visit Corinth twice, before and after Macedonia, so "second" means a second visit and its blessing.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "grace"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts read a similar Greek word meaning "joy", which differs by one letter and fits the mention of joy in verse 24 and 2:3. The SBLGNT follows the reading "grace", found in most early manuscripts. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: first: before going to Macedonia
alternatives: earlier: at an earlier time, before the plan changed
decisions.reason: πρότερον can mean "first" in a sequence or "earlier" in time. Verse 16 sets out the order of the trip: Corinth, Macedonia, Corinth again. Either reading fits the plan that was dropped.

decisions.choice: Paul's changed travel plans
decisions.reason: In 1 Corinthians 16:5-7 Paul planned to go through Macedonia and then come to Corinth. Here he describes a later plan, a double visit. He did not carry it out (1:23; 2:1), and his critics used the change against him. Judea was the goal because he was taking the collection to the believers in Jerusalem (1 Corinthians 16:1-4; Romans 15:25-26). Macedonia was the province north of Achaia, with Philippi and Thessalonica.

decisions.choice: to be sent on: helped on a journey with supplies and company
decisions.reason: προπεμφθῆναι was the regular word for a church's help to a traveling preacher: food, money, sometimes companions (Romans 15:24; 1 Corinthians 16:6; Titus 3:13).

decisions.choice: a second gift of grace (B); receive God's grace twice, through two visits from me (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the "second grace" was (see the meaning decision) and keep the key word "grace".

decisions.choice: pass through your city (B); stop with you (R)
decisions.reason: "Through you" means through Corinth, where they live.

decisions.choice: être mis en route par vous (L)
decisions.reason: "Être envoyé" would suggest that the church sends Paul on a mission; the verb means helping a traveller on his way with supplies and company (m5). "Mettre en route" says that without leaving Literal; Balanced and Readable say the help plainly.

decisions.choice: un segundo don de la gracia
decisions.reason: "Gracia" stays as the key term; "don" says that the second visit would bring them God's gift of grace (meaning decision), not a favor from Paul.

decisions.choice: kusafirishwa nanyi (L); mnisaidie katika safari yangu (B, R)
decisions.reason: To be sent on was to be given supplies and company for the road (meaning decision). Literal keeps the passive "kusafirishwa" (to be sent on one's way); Balanced and Readable say what the Corinthians would do. "Kusindikizwa" (to be escorted) names only the company.

decisions.choice: "ân điển" at every level for charis here
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "grace" (m2): a second gift of God's grace through a second visit (m1). The key term is kept; Readable adds how it would come. "Giu-đê" as in the Vietnamese Romans 15:31.

decisions.choice: "두 번째 은혜" (L); "두 번째 은혜의 선물" (B); "하나님의 은혜를 두 번" (R)
decisions.reason: "은혜" is a key term; the meaning decision reads it as a gift of God's grace brought by a second visit, and footnotes the reading "joy".

decisions.choice: "二度目の恵み" (L); "二度目の恵みの贈り物" (B); "神の恵みを二度受ける" (R)
decisions.reason: The key word "恵み" stays at every level; Balanced and Readable say what the second grace was (m1). "贈り物" keeps it apart from "賜物" for charisma (1:11).

source.text: τοῦτο οὖν βουλόμενος μήτι ἄρα τῇ ἐλαφρίᾳ ἐχρησάμην;

records.literal_gloss: This therefore wanting, [did] I then use the lightness?

en.L: So when I wanted this, did I really act with lightness?
en.B: So when I planned this, did I treat it lightly?
en.R: When I planned all this, I was not careless about it, was I?

fr.L: En voulant donc cela, ai-je donc agi avec légèreté ?
fr.B: Quand j’ai fait ce projet, l’ai-je donc pris à la légère ?
fr.R: Quand j’ai fait tous ces projets, je ne les ai pas faits à la légère, n’est-ce pas ?

es.L: Así que, queriendo esto, ¿acaso actué con ligereza?
es.B: Entonces, cuando planeé esto, ¿lo tomé a la ligera?
es.R: Cuando hice todos estos planes, no fui descuidado, ¿verdad?

sw.L: Basi nilipotaka hili, je, kweli nilitenda kwa wepesi?
sw.B: Basi nilipopanga hivyo, je, nililichukulia jambo hilo kwa wepesi?
sw.R: Nilipopanga hayo yote, sikuwa mzembe, sivyo?

vi.L: Vậy khi muốn như thế, có phải tôi đã hành động cách nhẹ dạ sao?
vi.B: Vậy khi lập kế hoạch ấy, có phải tôi đã xem nhẹ việc ấy không?
vi.R: Khi lập tất cả những kế hoạch ấy, tôi đâu có cẩu thả, phải không?

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 이렇게 계획했을 때 경솔하게 행했겠습니까?
ko.B: 내가 이런 계획을 세웠을 때 가볍게 생각했겠습니까?
ko.R: 내가 이 모든 것을 계획할 때 아무렇게나 한 것이 아니지 않습니까?

pt.L: Então, querendo isso, será que usei de leviandade?
pt.B: Então, quando planejei isso, será que agi levianamente?
pt.R: Quando planejei tudo isso, não fiz esses planos sem pensar, não é verdade?

am.L: እንግዲህ ይህን ስፈልግ በእርግጥ በቀላልነት አደረግኩትን?
am.B: ታዲያ ይህን ሳቅድ ነገሩን አቅልዬ አየኩትን?
am.R: ይህን ሁሉ ሳቅድ ግድየለሽ አልነበርኩም፤ ነበርኩ እንዴ?

hi.L: सो जब मैं यह चाहता था, तो क्या मैंने सचमुच हल्केपन से काम लिया?
hi.B: तो जब मैंने यह योजना बनाई, तो क्या मैंने इसे हल्के में लिया?
hi.R: जब मैंने यह सब योजना बनाई, तो मैं उसके बारे में लापरवाह तो नहीं था, है न?

ru.L: Итак, желая этого, разве я поступил с легкомыслием?
ru.B: Итак, когда я это задумывал, разве я отнёсся к этому легкомысленно?
ru.R: Когда я всё это задумывал, я ведь не был беспечным?

uk.L: Отже, коли я цього хотів, чи я справді діяв легковажно?
uk.B: Тож коли я так задумав, хіба я поставився до цього легковажно?
uk.R: Коли я все це планував, я ж не був легковажним, правда?

ja.L: それで、このことを望んでいたとき、まさか、わたしは軽はずみに事を行ったのでしょうか？
ja.B: それでは、このように計画したとき、わたしは軽い気持ちでそうしたのでしょうか？
ja.R: わたしがこの計画を立てたとき、いいかげんな気持ちだったわけではありませんよね？

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer "no"
decisions.reason: μήτι introduces a question to which the speaker expects a negative answer. Paul is not unsure; he is rejecting a charge.

decisions.choice: lightness: fickleness, making plans carelessly and dropping them
decisions.reason: ἐλαφρίᾳ means lightness, here in the sense of being unreliable. The article ("the lightness") may point to the very fickleness the Corinthians had accused him of.

decisions.choice: I was not careless about it, was I?
decisions.reason: A tag question shows young readers that the expected answer is "no", as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: kwa wepesi
decisions.reason: "Wepesi" is lightness, the Greek picture; with "kutenda" or "kuchukulia" it means treating a matter lightly. "Kigeugeu" (fickleness) would say the same plainly and is close to the "Ndiyo, ndiyo" and "Hapana, hapana" of the next sentence.

decisions.choice: "まさか……でしょうか？" (L); "……わけではありませんよね？" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek question expects the answer "no" (m1); Literal marks it with "まさか", Readable with a tag question, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ἢ ἃ βουλεύομαι κατὰ σάρκα βουλεύομαι, ἵνα ᾖ παρ’ ἐμοὶ τὸ Ναὶ ναὶ καὶ τὸ Οὒ οὔ;

records.literal_gloss: Or what I plan, according to flesh do I plan, so that there may be with me the Yes yes and the No no?

en.L: Or what I plan, do I plan according to [the] flesh, so that with me there may be "Yes, yes" and "No, no"?
en.B: Or are my plans made by merely human standards, so that with me it is "Yes, yes" and "No, no" at once?
en.R: Do I make plans the way selfish people do? Do I say "Yes, yes" and then "No, no" whenever it suits me?

fr.L: Ou ce que je projette, est-ce selon la chair que je le projette, de sorte qu’il y ait chez moi le « Oui, oui » et le « Non, non » ?
fr.B: Ou bien mes projets sont-ils faits selon des critères purement humains, de sorte que chez moi ce soit à la fois « Oui, oui » et « Non, non » ?
fr.R: Est-ce que je fais des projets comme les gens égoïstes ? Est-ce que je dis « Oui, oui » puis « Non, non », selon ce qui m’arrange ?

es.L: ¿O lo que planeo, lo planeo según [la] carne, para que haya en mí el «Sí, sí» y el «No, no»?
es.B: ¿O hago mis planes con criterios meramente humanos, de modo que conmigo es «Sí, sí» y «No, no» a la vez?
es.R: ¿Hago planes como lo hace la gente egoísta? ¿Digo «Sí, sí» y luego «No, no» cuando me conviene?

sw.L: Au mambo ninayoyapanga, je, nayapanga kwa kufuata mwili, ili kwangu kuwe na "Ndiyo, ndiyo" na "Hapana, hapana"?
sw.B: Au je, mipango yangu inafanywa kwa vipimo vya kibinadamu tu, hata kwangu iwe "Ndiyo, ndiyo" na "Hapana, hapana" wakati mmoja?
sw.R: Je, mimi hupanga mambo kama watu wenye ubinafsi wanavyofanya? Je, nasema "Ndiyo, ndiyo" kisha "Hapana, hapana" kila inaponifaa?

vi.L: Hay những gì tôi dự định, tôi dự định theo xác thịt, để nơi tôi có cả "Phải, phải" lẫn "Không, không" sao?
vi.B: Hay những kế hoạch của tôi được lập theo tiêu chuẩn thuần túy con người, để nơi tôi cùng một lúc vừa "Phải, phải" vừa "Không, không" sao?
vi.R: Tôi có lập kế hoạch như những người ích kỷ không? Tôi có nói "Phải, phải" rồi lại "Không, không" bất cứ khi nào có lợi cho mình không?

ko.L: 아니면 내가 계획하는 것들을 육신을 따라 계획해서, 나에게 "예, 예"와 "아니요, 아니요"가 [함께] 있겠습니까?
ko.B: 아니면 내가 사람의 기준으로 계획을 세워서, "예, 예" 하면서 동시에 "아니요, 아니요" 하겠습니까?
ko.R: 내가 자기만 생각하는 사람들처럼 계획을 세우겠습니까? 내 마음대로 "예, 예" 했다가 "아니요, 아니요" 하겠습니까?

pt.L: Ou o que planejo, planejo segundo a carne, para que haja comigo o "Sim, sim" e o "Não, não"?
pt.B: Ou será que faço os meus planos segundo critérios meramente humanos, de modo que comigo é "Sim, sim" e "Não, não" ao mesmo tempo?
pt.R: Será que faço planos como fazem as pessoas egoístas? Será que digo "Sim, sim" e depois "Não, não", sempre que me convém?

am.L: ወይስ የማቅደውን በእኔ ዘንድ «አዎን፣ አዎን» ደግሞም «አይደለም፣ አይደለም» እንዲሆን እንደ ሥጋ አቅዳለሁን?
am.B: ወይስ በእኔ ዘንድ በአንድ ጊዜ «አዎን፣ አዎን» ደግሞም «አይደለም፣ አይደለም» እንዲሆን ዕቅዶቼን በሰው መለኪያ ብቻ አወጣለሁ?
am.R: ራስ ወዳድ ሰዎች እንደሚያደርጉት ዕቅድ አወጣለሁ? ሲመቸኝ «አዎን፣ አዎን» ብዬ ከዚያ «አይደለም፣ አይደለም» እላለሁ?

hi.L: या जो योजनाएँ मैं बनाता हूँ, क्या मैं उन्हें शरीर के अनुसार बनाता हूँ, कि मेरे यहाँ "हाँ, हाँ" भी हो और "नहीं, नहीं" भी?
hi.B: या क्या मेरी योजनाएँ केवल मानवीय मापदंडों से बनती हैं, कि मेरे यहाँ एक साथ "हाँ, हाँ" भी हो और "नहीं, नहीं" भी?
hi.R: क्या मैं स्वार्थी लोगों की तरह योजनाएँ बनाता हूँ? क्या मैं पहले "हाँ, हाँ" कहता हूँ और फिर जब मेरी मर्ज़ी हो, "नहीं, नहीं" कह देता हूँ?

ru.L: Или то, что я замышляю, по плоти замышляю, чтобы было у меня «Да, да» и «Нет, нет»?
ru.B: Или мои замыслы сделаны по чисто человеческим меркам, так что у меня одновременно «Да, да» и «Нет, нет»?
ru.R: Разве я строю планы так, как делают люди, которые думают только о себе? Разве я говорю «Да, да», а потом «Нет, нет», как мне удобно?

uk.L: Або те, що я задумую, чи задумую я за тілом, щоб у мене було «Так, так» і «Ні, ні»?
uk.B: Чи, може, я будую плани за суто людськими мірками, щоб у мене водночас було «Так, так» і «Ні, ні»?
uk.R: Чи я будую плани так, як роблять самолюбні люди? Чи кажу я «Так, так», а потім «Ні, ні», коли мені це вигідно?

ja.L: それとも、わたしは、計画することを肉に従って計画し、そのため、わたしのところでは「はい、はい」と「いいえ、いいえ」が[同時に]あるというのでしょうか？
ja.B: それとも、わたしの計画は人間的な基準で立てられていて、わたしの場合、「はい、はい」と「いいえ、いいえ」が同時にあるとでもいうのでしょうか？
ja.R: わたしは、自分勝手な人たちのように計画を立てているのでしょうか？都合のいいときには「はい、はい」と言い、すぐに「いいえ、いいえ」と言ったりするのでしょうか？

decisions.choice: by merely human standards: planning for one's own advantage
decisions.reason: κατὰ σάρκα describes plans made the way people do without God, shaped by self-interest. Some in Corinth said Paul lived this way (10:2); he answers the charge here and in verse 12.

decisions.choice: saying yes and no about the same thing: being unreliable
alternatives: an emphatic yes that truly means yes
decisions.reason: Elsewhere a doubled "yes" means a plain, honest yes (Matthew 5:37; James 5:12). Here, with "yes, yes" and "no, no" both "with me", the picture is of a man whose answer can be either, so that no one can rely on his word. Verse 18 confirms this: his word is not "Yes and No".

decisions.choice: by merely human standards (B); the way selfish people do (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 12, Literal keeps "flesh", while Balanced and Readable give the sense.

decisions.choice: at once (B); then ... whenever it suits me (R)
decisions.reason: These words make clear that the doubled yes and no describe unreliability, not emphasis (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "예" and "아니요" for yes and no, through verses 17-20
decisions.reason: The plain polite answers of Korean, so that "Yes" can stand as a word in verses 19-20 as well.

decisions.choice: እንደ ሥጋ (L); በሰው መለኪያ ብቻ (B); ራስ ወዳድ ሰዎች እንደሚያደርጉት (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps ሥጋ, 'flesh', as in all of Paul's letters. 'According to the flesh' means by human standards, for one's own advantage; Balanced says በሰው መለኪያ, 'by human measure', and Readable follows the English Readable. The same pattern holds where the phrase comes back (5:16; 10:2-3).

decisions.choice: «አዎን» (yes), «አይደለም» (no)
decisions.reason: አዎን and አይደለም are the plain words for yes and no; they stay the same through 1:17-20, where Paul's argument turns on them.

decisions.choice: "शरीर के अनुसार"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps flesh (sarx) as "शरीर", as Romans does; Balanced and Readable give the sense, as in verse 12.

decisions.choice: "肉に従って" (L); "人間的な基準で" (B); "自分勝手な人たちのように" (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 12: Literal keeps "flesh", Balanced and Readable give the sense (m1).

source.text: πιστὸς δὲ ὁ θεὸς ὅτι ὁ λόγος ἡμῶν ὁ πρὸς ὑμᾶς οὐκ ἔστιν Ναὶ καὶ Οὔ.

records.literal_gloss: But faithful [is] the God, that the word of us the [one] to you is not Yes and No.

en.L: But God [is] faithful, that our word to you is not "Yes and No."
en.B: But God is faithful, and our word to you is not "Yes" and "No" at once.
en.R: God is faithful. And just as surely, what we say to you does not mean "Yes" and "No" at the same time.

fr.L: Mais Dieu [est] fidèle : notre parole adressée à vous n’est pas « Oui et Non ».
fr.B: Mais Dieu est fidèle, et notre parole pour vous n’est pas à la fois « Oui » et « Non ».
fr.R: Dieu est fidèle. Et c’est aussi sûr que cela : ce que nous vous disons ne veut pas dire « Oui » et « Non » en même temps.

es.L: Pero fiel [es] Dios, que nuestra palabra a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no es «Sí y No».
es.B: Pero Dios es fiel, y nuestra palabra a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no es «Sí» y «No» a la vez.
es.R: Dios es fiel. Y con la misma seguridad, lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} decimos no significa «Sí» y «No» al mismo tiempo.

sw.L: Lakini Mungu [ni] mwaminifu, kwamba neno letu kwenu si "Ndiyo na Hapana."
sw.B: Lakini Mungu ni mwaminifu, na neno letu kwenu si "Ndiyo" na "Hapana" wakati mmoja.
sw.R: Mungu ni mwaminifu. Na kwa hakika hiyo hiyo, maneno tunayowaambia hayamaanishi "Ndiyo" na "Hapana" kwa wakati mmoja.

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời là thành tín, nên lời chúng tôi nói với anh chị em không phải là "Phải và Không."
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời là thành tín, và lời chúng tôi nói với anh chị em không phải cùng một lúc vừa "Phải" vừa "Không."
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời là thành tín. Và cũng chắc chắn như vậy, những gì chúng tôi nói với anh chị em không có nghĩa vừa "Phải" vừa "Không" cùng một lúc.

ko.L: 하나님께서 신실하신 것처럼, 여러분에게 한 우리의 말은 "예"이면서 "아니요"가 아닙니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 신실하신 것처럼 확실히, 우리가 여러분에게 한 말은 "예"이면서 동시에 "아니요"인 말이 아닙니다.
ko.R: 하나님은 신실하십니다. 그만큼 확실하게, 우리가 여러분에게 하는 말은 "예"와 "아니요"를 동시에 뜻하지 않습니다.

pt.L: Mas Deus [é] fiel, [e] a nossa palavra a vocês não é "Sim e Não."
pt.B: Mas Deus é fiel, e a nossa palavra a vocês não é "Sim" e "Não" ao mesmo tempo.
pt.R: Deus é fiel. E, com a mesma certeza, o que dizemos a vocês não quer dizer "Sim" e "Não" ao mesmo tempo.

am.L: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ታማኝ ነው፤ ለእናንተ የምንናገረው ቃላችን «አዎንና አይደለም» የሚል አይደለም።
am.B: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ታማኝ ነው፤ ለእናንተ የምንናገረውም ቃል በአንድ ጊዜ «አዎን» እና «አይደለም» የሚል አይደለም።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ታማኝ ነው። እርሱ ታማኝ እንደ ሆነ እንዲሁ የምንነግራችሁ ነገር በአንድ ጊዜ «አዎን» እና «አይደለም» ማለት አይደለም።

hi.L: पर परमेश्वर विश्वासयोग्य [हैं], कि तुमसे कहा गया हमारा वचन "हाँ और नहीं" नहीं है।
hi.B: पर परमेश्वर विश्वासयोग्य हैं, और तुमसे कहा गया हमारा वचन एक साथ "हाँ" और "नहीं" नहीं है।
hi.R: परमेश्वर विश्वासयोग्य हैं। और उतना ही पक्का यह है कि जो हम तुमसे कहते हैं, उसका मतलब एक ही समय में "हाँ" और "नहीं" नहीं होता।

ru.L: Но верен Бог, что слово наше к вам не есть «Да и Нет.»
ru.B: Но Бог верен, и наше слово к вам — не «Да» и «Нет» одновременно.
ru.R: Бог верен. И так же верно то, что наши слова к вам не означают «Да» и «Нет» одновременно.

uk.L: Але вірний Бог, що наше слово до вас не є «Так і Ні».
uk.B: Але Бог вірний, і наше слово до вас не є водночас «Так» і «Ні».
uk.R: Бог вірний. І так само певно те, що ми вам кажемо, не означає «Так» і «Ні» одночасно.

ja.L: しかし神は真実な方です。[その真実にかけて言いますが、]あなたがたに対するわたしたちの言葉は、「はい、またいいえ」ではありません。
ja.B: しかし、神は真実な方です。あなたがたに対するわたしたちの言葉も、「はい」であると同時に「いいえ」であるようなものではありません。
ja.R: 神は信頼できる方です。それと同じくらい確かに、わたしたちがみなさんに言うことは、「はい」と「いいえ」を同時に意味するようなものではありません。

decisions.choice: a form of oath: as surely as God is faithful
alternatives: a statement with a reason: God is faithful, because our word is not yes and no
decisions.reason: The phrase is like "God is my witness" (verse 23; Romans 1:9). Paul appeals to God's faithfulness to back his own: he is God's messenger, and God is not unreliable.

decisions.choice: our word: what we said to you, including the message we preached
decisions.reason: λόγος can mean speech in general or the message. Paul moves from his plans (verse 17) to his preaching (verse 19): if his message about Christ is reliable, so is his word about lesser things.

decisions.choice: at once (B); at the same time (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 17, the words say that yes and no together mark an unreliable word.

decisions.choice: "真実な方" (L, B); "信頼できる方" (R); "[その真実にかけて言いますが、]" (L)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Corinthians 1:9. The phrase works as an oath (m1); Literal supplies the link the Greek "that" makes, Balanced and Readable let the two sentences stand side by side.

source.text: ὁ τοῦ θεοῦ γὰρ υἱὸς Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ὁ ἐν ὑμῖν δι’ ἡμῶν κηρυχθείς, δι’ ἐμοῦ καὶ Σιλουανοῦ καὶ Τιμοθέου, οὐκ ἐγένετο Ναὶ καὶ Οὒ, ἀλλὰ Ναὶ ἐν αὐτῷ γέγονεν·

records.literal_gloss: For the of God Son, Jesus Christ, the [one] among you through us having been preached, through me and Silvanus and Timothy, not did become Yes and No, but Yes in him has become;

en.L: For the Son of God, Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, who was proclaimed among you through us, through me and Silvanus and Timothy, did not become "Yes and No," but in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} it has become "Yes."
en.B: Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the Son of God, whom Silvanus, Timothy and I proclaimed among you, did not turn out to be "Yes" and "No." In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} "Yes" has become a reality.
en.R: Silvanus, Timothy and I preached to you about Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the Son of God. He was never "Yes" and "No" at the same time. With {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} it is always "Yes."

fr.L: Car le Fils de Dieu, Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, qui a été proclamé parmi vous par nous, par moi et Silvain et Timothée, n’est pas devenu « Oui et Non », mais en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} « Oui » est advenu.
fr.B: Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, le Fils de Dieu, que Silvain, Timothée et moi avons annoncé parmi vous, ne s’est pas révélé « Oui » et « Non ». En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, le « Oui » est devenu réalité.
fr.R: Silvain, Timothée et moi, nous vous avons annoncé Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, le Fils de Dieu. Il n’a jamais été « Oui » et « Non » en même temps. Avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, c’est toujours « Oui ».

es.L: Porque el Hijo de Dios, {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} que fue proclamado entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} por medio de nosotros, por mí y Silvano y Timoteo, no fue «Sí y No», sino que en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha llegado a ser «Sí».
es.B: {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} el Hijo de Dios, a quien Silvano, Timoteo y yo proclamamos entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, no resultó ser «Sí» y «No». En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} el «Sí» se ha hecho realidad.
es.R: Silvano, Timoteo y yo {{plural_you:les|os}} predicamos acerca de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} el Hijo de Dios. Él nunca fue «Sí» y «No» al mismo tiempo. Con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} siempre es «Sí».

sw.L: Kwa maana Mwana wa Mungu, Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, aliyehubiriwa kwenu kupitia sisi, kupitia mimi na Silwano na Timotheo, hakuwa "Ndiyo na Hapana," bali ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} imekuwa "Ndiyo."
sw.B: Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mwana wa Mungu, ambaye mimi, Silwano na Timotheo tulimhubiri kwenu, hakuonekana kuwa "Ndiyo" na "Hapana." Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} "Ndiyo" imekuwa jambo la hakika.
sw.R: Mimi, Silwano na Timotheo tuliwahubiria habari za Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mwana wa Mungu. Yeye hakuwa kamwe "Ndiyo" na "Hapana" kwa wakati mmoja. Kwake ni "Ndiyo" siku zote.

vi.L: Vì Con của Đức Chúa Trời, là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Đấng đã được chúng tôi rao giảng giữa anh chị em, tức là tôi, Sin-vanh và Ti-mô-thê, đã không trở thành "Phải và Không," nhưng trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành "Phải."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Con của Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng mà Sin-vanh, Ti-mô-thê và tôi đã rao giảng giữa anh chị em, không phải là "Phải" và "Không." Trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, "Phải" đã trở thành hiện thực.
vi.R: Sin-vanh, Ti-mô-thê và tôi đã rao giảng cho anh chị em về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Con của Đức Chúa Trời. Ngài không bao giờ vừa "Phải" vừa "Không" cùng một lúc. Với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, luôn luôn là "Phải."

ko.L: 우리, 곧 나와 실루아노와 디모데가 여러분 가운데 전파한 하나님의 아들 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}는 "예"이면서 "아니요"가 되지 않으셨고, 그분 안에서는 "예"가 되었습니다.
ko.B: 실루아노와 디모데와 내가 여러분 가운데 전한 하나님의 아들 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 "예"이면서 동시에 "아니요"가 되신 적이 없습니다. 그분 안에서는 "예"가 이루어졌습니다.
ko.R: 실루아노와 디모데와 나는 하나님의 아들 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}에 대해 여러분에게 전했습니다. 그분은 결코 "예"와 "아니요"를 동시에 뜻하지 않으셨습니다. 그분과 함께라면 언제나 "예"입니다.

pt.L: Pois o Filho de Deus, Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, que foi proclamado entre vocês por nós, por mim, e Silvano, e Timóteo, não se tornou "Sim e Não," mas {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} veio a ser "Sim."
pt.B: Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, o Filho de Deus, que Silvano, Timóteo e eu proclamamos entre vocês, não foi "Sim" e "Não." O "Sim" se tornou realidade {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}.
pt.R: Silvano, Timóteo e eu anunciamos a vocês Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, o Filho de Deus. Ele nunca foi "Sim" e "Não" ao mesmo tempo. Com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é sempre "Sim."

am.L: በእኛ በኩል፣ በእኔና በሲልዋኖስ በጢሞቴዎስም በኩል በመካከላችሁ የተሰበከው የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} «አዎንና አይደለም» አልሆነምና፤ ነገር ግን በእርሱ «አዎን» ሆኗል።
am.B: ሲልዋኖስ፣ ጢሞቴዎስና እኔ በመካከላችሁ የሰበክነው የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} «አዎን» እና «አይደለም» ሆኖ አልተገኘም። በእርሱ «አዎን» እውን ሆኗል።
am.R: ሲልዋኖስ፣ ጢሞቴዎስና እኔ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ልጅ ስለ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ሰበክንላችሁ። እርሱ በአንድ ጊዜ «አዎን» እና «አይደለም» ሆኖ አያውቅም። በእርሱ ሁልጊዜ «አዎን» ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि परमेश्वर के पुत्र, यीशु मसीह, जिनका प्रचार हमारे द्वारा, अर्थात् मेरे और सिलवानुस और तीमुथियुस के द्वारा, तुम्हारे बीच किया गया, "हाँ और नहीं" नहीं हुए, पर उनमें "हाँ" हो गया है।
hi.B: परमेश्वर के पुत्र यीशु मसीह, जिनका प्रचार सिलवानुस, तीमुथियुस और मैंने तुम्हारे बीच किया, "हाँ" और "नहीं" नहीं निकले। उनमें "हाँ" सच हो चुका है।
hi.R: सिलवानुस, तीमुथियुस और मैंने तुम्हें परमेश्वर के पुत्र यीशु मसीह के बारे में प्रचार किया। वे कभी एक ही समय में "हाँ" और "नहीं" नहीं थे। उनमें हमेशा "हाँ" ही है।

ru.L: Ведь Сын Божий Иисус {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}, проповеданный среди вас нами — мной, и Силуаном, и Тимофеем, — не был «Да и Нет», но в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} было «Да.»
ru.B: Сын Божий Иисус {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}, которого мы — Силуан, Тимофей и я — проповедовали среди вас, не оказался «Да» и «Нет.» В {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} «Да» стало действительностью.
ru.R: Силуан, Тимофей и я проповедовали вам об Иисусе {{christos:Христе|Мессии}}, Сыне Божьем. Он никогда не был «Да» и «Нет» одновременно. В {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} всегда «Да.»

uk.L: Бо Син Божий, Ісус {{christos:Христос|Месія}}, якого проголошено серед вас через нас — через мене, і Силуана, і Тимофія, — не був «Так і Ні», але в {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} стало «Так».
uk.B: Ісус {{christos:Христос|Месія}}, Син Божий, якого ми — Силуан, Тимофій і я — проголошували серед вас, не виявився «Так» і «Ні». У {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} «Так» стало дійсністю.
uk.R: Силуан, Тимофій і я проповідували вам про Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месію}}, Сина Божого. Він ніколи не був «Так» і «Ні» одночасно. З {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} завжди «Так».

ja.L: なぜなら、わたしたちによって、すなわちわたしとシルワノとテモテによって、あなたがたの間で宣べ伝えられた神の子、イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は、「はい、またいいえ」とはならず、この方にあって「はい」となっているからです。
ja.B: シルワノとテモテとわたしが、あなたがたの間で宣べ伝えた神の子イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は、「はい」であって「いいえ」でもあるような方ではありませんでした。この方においては、「はい」が実現しているのです。
ja.R: シルワノとテモテとわたしは、神の子イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}のことを、みなさんに伝えました。この方は、「はい」と「いいえ」を同時に言うような方ではありませんでした。この方においては、いつも「はい」なのです。

decisions.choice: Silvanus: Paul's companion, called Silas in Acts
decisions.reason: Silvanus is the Latin form of the name; Acts calls him Silas. He and Timothy were with Paul when the church in Corinth was founded (Acts 18:5), and they join him in writing 1 and 2 Thessalonians (1 Thessalonians 1:1).

decisions.choice: Christ himself is God's "yes": in him God's word is fully reliable
decisions.reason: Paul's point is not Jesus' speech but who he is: in him God has kept his word, as verse 20 explains. Paul's own reliability rests on the reliability of the Christ he preached.

decisions.choice: past and lasting: Christ did not prove to be yes and no; in him yes has come and remains
decisions.reason: ἐγένετο is aorist, looking at Christ as he was preached; γέγονεν is perfect, a yes that came and still stands.

decisions.choice: Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: Silvanus, Timothy and I
alternatives: through me and Silvanus and Timothy
decisions.reason: English courtesy puts "I" last; Balanced and Readable also put the preachers first and make them the subject, so the sentence is easier to follow. Literal keeps the Greek order.

decisions.choice: "Yes" has become a reality (B); it is always "Yes" (R)
alternatives: in him it has become Yes
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the perfect tense, a yes that has come true; Readable says it stands.

decisions.choice: Silvain
decisions.reason: The usual French form of the name Paul uses. As in English, it is not changed to "Silas", the form Acts uses for the same man (m1).

decisions.choice: Silvano
decisions.reason: The Greek has the Latin name Silvanus, so Spanish writes "Silvano", as the English keeps "Silvanus"; the meaning decision says he is the Silas of Acts.

decisions.choice: Silwano
decisions.reason: Paul writes the Latin name Silvanus, so Swahili keeps its form, "Silwano", at every level, as the English keeps "Silvanus"; Acts calls the same man "Sila" (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "Sin-vanh" for Silvanus
decisions.reason: As the book-wide choice keeps "Silvanus", not "Silas"; "Sin-vanh" is the form of the Vietnamese 1 and 2 Thessalonians.

decisions.choice: "실루아노" at every level
decisions.reason: The project's choice keeps "Silvanus", as Paul writes it, not "Silas" of Acts; "실루아노" is the form of 1 Thessalonians 1:1.

decisions.choice: ሲልዋኖስ (Silvanus)
decisions.reason: The Greek has the longer Latin name, which Paul uses; Amharic keeps it, as the English does, and the meaning decision says he is Silas of Acts.

decisions.choice: "सिलवानुस"
decisions.reason: Paul's form of the name is kept; Acts calls the same man "सीलास" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: Иисус {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}
decisions.reason: The title setting; the options are inflected for the case ("об Иисусе Христе|Мессии" in Readable).

decisions.choice: Силуан
decisions.reason: The Greek name here is Silvanus, the Latin form; the corinthians terms note keeps it apart from the Silas of Acts (m1).

decisions.choice: "シルワノ"
decisions.reason: The letter has the Latin name Silvanus, not Acts' Silas (book terms; m1).

source.text: ὅσαι γὰρ ἐπαγγελίαι θεοῦ, ἐν αὐτῷ τὸ Ναί· διὸ καὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ τὸ Ἀμὴν τῷ θεῷ πρὸς δόξαν δι’ ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: For as many as promises of God [are], in him [is] the Yes; therefore also through him the Amen to the God for glory through us.

en.L: For as many as [are the] promises of God, in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [is] the "Yes." Therefore also through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [is] the "Amen" to God for glory through us.
en.B: However many promises God has made, in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} each one is "Yes." So it is through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} too that we answer God with "Amen," and God is given glory through us.
en.R: God has made many promises, and in Jesus every one of them is "Yes." That is why we say "Amen" to God through Jesus, and God receives glory through us.

fr.L: Car autant [il y a] de promesses de Dieu, en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [est] le « Oui » ; c’est pourquoi aussi par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [est] l’« Amen » à Dieu pour la gloire, par nous.
fr.B: Toutes les promesses que Dieu a faites, si nombreuses soient-elles, trouvent en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} leur « Oui ». C’est donc aussi par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que nous répondons « Amen » à Dieu, et que Dieu reçoit la gloire par nous.
fr.R: Dieu a fait beaucoup de promesses, et en Jésus, chacune d’elles est « Oui ». C’est pour cela que nous disons « Amen » à Dieu par Jésus, et que Dieu reçoit la gloire grâce à nous.

es.L: Porque cuantas [son las] promesas de Dios, en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [está] el «Sí»; por eso también por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el «Amén» a Dios para gloria por medio de nosotros.
es.B: Por muchas que sean las promesas que Dios ha hecho, en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cada una es «Sí». Por eso también por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} respondemos a Dios con el «Amén», y Dios recibe gloria por medio de nosotros.
es.R: Dios ha hecho muchas promesas, y en Jesús cada una de ellas es «Sí». Por eso, por medio de Jesús, decimos «Amén» a Dios, y Dios recibe gloria por medio de nosotros.

sw.L: Kwa maana ahadi za Mungu ziwe nyingi kiasi gani, ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [ziko] "Ndiyo." Kwa hiyo pia kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [kuna] "Amina" kwa Mungu kwa utukufu kupitia sisi.
sw.B: Ahadi za Mungu ziwe nyingi kiasi gani, ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kila moja ni "Ndiyo." Ndiyo sababu ni kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} pia tunamjibu Mungu "Amina," na Mungu anapata utukufu kupitia sisi.
sw.R: Mungu ametoa ahadi nyingi, na ndani ya Yesu kila moja ni "Ndiyo." Ndiyo sababu kupitia Yesu tunamwambia Mungu "Amina," na Mungu anapata utukufu kupitia sisi.

vi.L: Vì mọi lời hứa của Đức Chúa Trời, trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [đều là] "Phải"; vì vậy qua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng [có] "A-men" dâng lên Đức Chúa Trời để được vinh quang qua chúng tôi.
vi.B: Dù Đức Chúa Trời đã hứa bao nhiêu điều, thì trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mỗi lời hứa đều là "Phải." Vì vậy, cũng qua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà chúng tôi đáp lời Đức Chúa Trời bằng "A-men," và Đức Chúa Trời được tôn vinh qua chúng tôi.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã hứa nhiều điều, và trong Đức Giê-xu, mọi lời hứa ấy đều là "Phải." Vì vậy, qua Đức Giê-xu, chúng tôi nói "A-men" với Đức Chúa Trời, và Đức Chúa Trời được tôn vinh qua chúng tôi.

ko.L: 하나님의 약속이 얼마나 많든지 그분 안에서 "예"가 됩니다. 그러므로 그분을 통하여 우리가 하나님께 "아멘" 하여 하나님께 영광을 돌립니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 하신 약속이 아무리 많아도, 그 약속은 모두 그분 안에서 "예"가 됩니다. 그래서 우리도 그분을 통해 하나님께 "아멘" 하고 대답하고, 우리를 통해 하나님께서 영광을 받으십니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 많은 약속을 하셨습니다. 그리고 예수 안에서 그 모든 약속이 "예"가 됩니다. 그래서 우리는 예수를 통해 하나님께 "아멘" 하고 말합니다. 그리고 하나님께서는 우리를 통해 영광을 받으십니다.

pt.L: Pois quantas forem as promessas de Deus, {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} [está] o "Sim." Por isso também por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} [está] o "Amém" a Deus, para glória, por meio de nós.
pt.B: Por mais numerosas que sejam as promessas que Deus fez, {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} cada uma delas é "Sim." Por isso também é por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} que respondemos a Deus com o "Amém," e Deus recebe glória por meio de nós.
pt.R: Deus fez muitas promessas, e em Jesus cada uma delas é "Sim." É por isso que, por meio de Jesus, dizemos "Amém" a Deus, e Deus recebe glória por meio de nós.

am.L: የእግዚአብሔር የተስፋ ቃሎች ምንም ያህል ቢሆኑ በእርሱ «አዎን» ናቸውና፤ ስለዚህ ደግሞ በእኛ በኩል ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር በእርሱ በኩል «አሜን» [ይባላል]።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር የገባቸው የተስፋ ቃሎች ምንም ያህል ቢሆኑ፣ በእርሱ እያንዳንዳቸው «አዎን» ናቸው። ስለዚህ ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር «አሜን» ብለን የምንመልሰው በእርሱ በኩል ነው፤ እግዚአብሔርም በእኛ በኩል ይከብራል።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ብዙ የተስፋ ቃሎችን ሰጥቷል፤ በኢየሱስም እያንዳንዳቸው «አዎን» ናቸው። ስለዚህም በኢየሱስ በኩል ለእግዚአብሔር «አሜን» እንላለን፤ እግዚአብሔርም በእኛ በኩል ክብርን ይቀበላል።

hi.L: क्योंकि परमेश्वर की जितनी भी प्रतिज्ञाएँ हैं, उनमें "हाँ" [है]। इसलिए उनके द्वारा परमेश्वर की महिमा के लिए हमारे द्वारा "आमीन" भी [कहा जाता है]।
hi.B: परमेश्वर ने चाहे कितनी भी प्रतिज्ञाएँ की हों, उनमें हर एक "हाँ" है। इसलिए उन्हीं के द्वारा हम भी परमेश्वर को "आमीन" कहकर उत्तर देते हैं, और हमारे द्वारा परमेश्वर की महिमा होती है।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने बहुत-सी प्रतिज्ञाएँ की हैं, और यीशु में उनमें से हर एक "हाँ" है। इसीलिए हम यीशु के द्वारा परमेश्वर से "आमीन" कहते हैं, और हमारे द्वारा परमेश्वर की महिमा होती है।

ru.L: Ведь сколько обетований Божьих, в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} «Да.» Поэтому и через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} «Аминь» Богу во славу через нас.
ru.B: Сколько бы обетований ни дал Бог, в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} каждое из них — «Да.» Поэтому и через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} мы отвечаем Богу «Аминь», и Бог получает славу через нас.
ru.R: Бог дал много обещаний, и в Иисусе каждое из них — «Да.» Поэтому через Иисуса мы говорим Богу «Аминь», и Бог получает славу через нас.

uk.L: Бо скільки є обітниць Божих, у {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} [є] «Так». Тому й через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} [звучить] «Амінь» Богові на славу через нас.
uk.B: Хоч скільки обітниць дав Бог, у {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} кожна з них — «Так». Тому й через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} ми відповідаємо Богові «Амінь», і Бог отримує славу через нас.
uk.R: Бог дав багато обіцянок, і в Ісусі кожна з них — «Так». Ось чому ми через Ісуса кажемо Богові «Амінь», і Бог отримує славу через нас.

ja.L: なぜなら、神の約束がどれほど多くあっても、この方にあって「はい」となるからです。それゆえ、この方を通して、わたしたちを通して、神に栄光[を帰する]ための「アーメン」も[唱えられるのです]。
ja.B: 神がどれほど多くの約束をなさっていても、それらはすべてこの方において「はい」となります。それで、わたしたちもこの方を通して「アーメン」と神にお答えし、わたしたちを通して神に栄光が帰されるのです。
ja.R: 神はたくさんの約束をしてくださいましたが、イエスにおいて、そのどれもが「はい」となりました。ですから、わたしたちはイエスを通して、神に「アーメン」と言います。そして神は、わたしたちを通して栄光をお受けになるのです。

decisions.choice: every promise God has made is kept in Christ
decisions.reason: God's promises in the Old Testament, to Abraham, to David and through the prophets, find their fulfillment in Christ (Romans 15:8; Galatians 3:16). In him God says "yes" to them all.

decisions.choice: Amen: "it is true, let it be so"
decisions.reason: Ἀμὴν is a Hebrew word carried over into Greek untranslated, meaning "firm, true". It answers God's "yes" with the church's agreement.

decisions.choice: the Amen spoken by the church in worship
decisions.reason: Believers said "Amen" aloud in their gatherings to join in prayers and thanksgivings (1 Corinthians 14:16). Paul pictures the congregation saying it to God through Christ.

decisions.choice: "through us": through Paul and his companions, who brought the Corinthians the message and lead their Amen
decisions.reason: The phrase may include the whole church saying Amen, but in the setting of verses 18-19 it points first to the preachers: through their preaching God's yes was heard and the Amen came to be spoken. Either way, God receives the glory.

decisions.choice: in Jesus; through Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus, whom "him" refers to (verse 19), because a new paragraph may begin here.

decisions.choice: Amen
decisions.reason: Kept untranslated, as the Greek itself kept it; the word is familiar from prayer.

decisions.choice: የተስፋ ቃል (promise)
decisions.reason: ተስፋ alone also means hope (1:7, 10), so a promise of God is የተስፋ ቃል, 'word of promise', keeping the two apart.

decisions.choice: обетование (L, B); обещание (R)
decisions.reason: The settled term of Romans for God's promises.

decisions.choice: "アーメン"
decisions.reason: Kept untranslated, as the Greek kept the Hebrew word; it is the Amen said in worship (m2, m3).

source.text: ὁ δὲ βεβαιῶν ἡμᾶς σὺν ὑμῖν εἰς Χριστὸν καὶ χρίσας ἡμᾶς θεός, ὁ καὶ σφραγισάμενος ἡμᾶς καὶ δοὺς τὸν ἀρραβῶνα τοῦ πνεύματος ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And the [one] confirming us with you into Christ and having anointed us [is] God, \v 22 the [one] also having sealed us and having given the down payment of the Spirit in the hearts of us.

en.L: Now the [one] who makes us firm with you in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} and anointed us [is] God, \v 22 who also sealed us and gave [us] the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
en.B: It is God who makes us secure in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, us together with you. God anointed us, \v 22 and God sealed us as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own and gave us the Spirit in our hearts as a down payment.
en.R: God is the one who makes both us and you strong in our life with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. God chose us and gave us a special task. \v 22 God put a mark on us to show that we belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. And God put the Spirit in our hearts. The Spirit is like a first payment, a promise that God will give us everything else {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has promised.

fr.L: Or celui qui nous affermit avec vous {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} et qui nous a oints, [c’est] Dieu, \v 22 qui aussi nous a marqués d’un sceau et a donné l’acompte de l’Esprit dans nos cœurs.
fr.B: C’est Dieu qui nous rend solides {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, nous avec vous. Dieu nous a oints, \v 22 Dieu nous a marqués de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sceau comme {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propriété, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis dans nos cœurs l’Esprit comme un acompte.
fr.R: C’est Dieu qui nous rend forts, nous et vous, dans notre vie avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Dieu nous a choisis et nous a donné une mission spéciale. \v 22 Dieu a mis une marque sur nous pour montrer que nous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenons. Et Dieu a mis l’Esprit dans nos cœurs. L’Esprit est comme un premier versement : c’est la promesse que Dieu nous donnera tout le reste de ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a promis.

es.L: Y el que nos confirma con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} y nos ungió [es] Dios, \v 22 quien también nos selló y [nos] dio el anticipo del Espíritu en nuestros corazones.
es.B: Es Dios quien nos da firmeza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, a nosotros junto con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Dios nos ungió, \v 22 nos selló como {{deity_pronoun:suyos|Suyos}} y puso en nuestros corazones el Espíritu como anticipo.
es.R: Dios es quien nos hace fuertes, a nosotros y a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, en nuestra vida con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. Dios nos eligió y nos dio una tarea especial. \v 22 Dios nos puso una marca para mostrar que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecemos. Y Dios puso el Espíritu en nuestros corazones. El Espíritu es como un primer pago, una promesa de que Dios nos dará todo lo demás que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha prometido.

sw.L: Basi anayetuimarisha pamoja nanyi katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na aliyetutia mafuta, [ni] Mungu, \v 22 ambaye pia alitutia muhuri na kutupa malipo ya awali ya Roho mioyoni mwetu.
sw.B: Ni Mungu anayetufanya imara katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, sisi pamoja nanyi. Mungu alitutia mafuta, \v 22 akatutia muhuri kuonyesha kwamba sisi ni {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akatupa Roho mioyoni mwetu kama malipo ya awali.
sw.R: Mungu ndiye anayetufanya sisi na ninyi kuwa imara katika maisha yetu pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Mungu alituchagua na kutupa kazi maalum. \v 22 Mungu alitutia alama kuonyesha kwamba sisi ni {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Tena Mungu aliweka Roho ndani ya mioyo yetu. Roho ni kama malipo ya kwanza, ahadi kwamba Mungu atatupa kila kitu kingine alichoahidi.

vi.L: Nhưng Đấng làm cho chúng tôi cùng với anh chị em được vững vàng trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} và đã xức dầu cho chúng tôi là Đức Chúa Trời, \v 22 là Đấng cũng đã đóng ấn chúng tôi và ban tiền đặt cọc của Thánh Linh trong lòng chúng tôi.
vi.B: Chính Đức Chúa Trời làm cho chúng tôi, cùng với anh chị em, được vững vàng trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Đức Chúa Trời đã xức dầu cho chúng tôi, \v 22 đã đóng ấn trên chúng tôi để chúng tôi thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và ban Thánh Linh vào lòng chúng tôi như một khoản tiền đặt cọc bảo đảm.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng làm cho cả chúng tôi lẫn anh chị em được vững mạnh trong đời sống với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn chúng tôi và giao cho chúng tôi một công việc đặc biệt. \v 22 Đức Chúa Trời đã đánh dấu trên chúng tôi để cho thấy chúng tôi thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Và Đức Chúa Trời đã ban Thánh Linh vào lòng chúng tôi. Thánh Linh giống như một khoản trả trước, một lời hứa rằng Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban cho chúng tôi mọi điều khác {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa.

ko.L: 우리를 여러분과 함께 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 굳게 세우시고 우리에게 기름을 부으신 분은 하나님이십니다. \v 22 그분은 또한 우리에게 인을 치시고 우리 마음에 성령을 보증금으로 주셨습니다.
ko.B: 우리를 여러분과 함께 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 굳게 서 있게 하시는 분은 하나님이십니다. 하나님께서 우리에게 기름을 부으시고, \v 22 우리에게 그분의 것이라는 인을 치시고, 보증금으로 우리 마음에 성령을 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 우리와 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께하는 삶에서 굳게 서 있도록 하시는 분은 하나님이십니다. 하나님께서는 우리를 택하셔서 특별한 일을 맡기셨습니다. \v 22 하나님께서는 우리가 그분께 속해 있다는 표시를 우리에게 해 주셨습니다. 그리고 우리 마음에 성령을 주셨습니다. 성령께서는 첫 지불금과 같은 분이십니다. 하나님께서 약속하신 나머지 모든 것도 주시겠다는 약속입니다.

pt.L: Ora, quem nos firma com vocês {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} e nos ungiu [é] Deus, \v 22 que também nos selou e [nos] deu o sinal do Espírito em nossos corações.
pt.B: É Deus quem nos mantém firmes {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, a nós junto com vocês. Deus nos ungiu, \v 22 nos selou como propriedade {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} e pôs em nosso coração o Espírito como sinal de pagamento.
pt.R: Deus é quem dá firmeza a nós e a vocês na nossa vida com {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}. Deus nos escolheu e nos deu uma tarefa especial. \v 22 Deus pôs em nós uma marca para mostrar que pertencemos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. E Deus pôs o Espírito em nosso coração. O Espírito é como uma primeira parcela, uma promessa de que Deus vai nos dar tudo o mais que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} prometeu.

am.L: ከእናንተም ጋር {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} የሚያጸናንና የቀባን እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ \v 22 እርሱም ደግሞ ያተመን በልባችንም የመንፈስን ቀብድ የሰጠን ነው።
am.B: እኛን ከእናንተ ጋር {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} የሚያጸናን እግዚአብሔር ነው። እግዚአብሔር ቀባን፤ \v 22 እግዚአብሔርም የራሱ እንድንሆን አተመን፤ መንፈስንም በልባችን ቀብድ አድርጎ ሰጠን።
am.R: እኛንም እናንተንም {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} ጋር ባለን ሕይወት የሚያበረታን እግዚአብሔር ነው። እግዚአብሔር መረጠን፤ ልዩ ሥራም ሰጠን። \v 22 የእርሱ መሆናችንን ለማሳየት ምልክት አደረገብን። መንፈስንም በልባችን አኖረ። መንፈስ እንደ መጀመሪያ ክፍያ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ቃል የገባልንን ሌላውን ሁሉ እንደሚሰጠን ማረጋገጫ ነው።

hi.L: और जो हमें तुम्हारे साथ मसीह में दृढ़ करते हैं और जिन्होंने हमारा अभिषेक किया, वे परमेश्वर [हैं], \v 22 जिन्होंने हम पर मुहर भी लगाई और हमारे हृदयों में आत्मा का बयाना दिया।
hi.B: परमेश्वर ही हैं जो हमें, तुम्हारे साथ-साथ, मसीह में स्थिर करते हैं। परमेश्वर ने हमारा अभिषेक किया, \v 22 और परमेश्वर ने हम पर अपनी मुहर लगाकर हमें अपना ठहराया, और बयाने के रूप में हमारे हृदयों में आत्मा दिया।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ही हैं जो हमें और तुम्हें, दोनों को, मसीह के साथ हमारे जीवन में मज़बूत करते हैं। परमेश्वर ने हमें चुना और एक ख़ास काम सौंपा। \v 22 परमेश्वर ने हम पर एक निशान लगाया, यह दिखाने के लिए कि हम उनके हैं। और परमेश्वर ने अपना आत्मा हमारे दिलों में रखा। आत्मा पहली क़िस्त की तरह है, एक वचन कि परमेश्वर ने जो कुछ और देने की प्रतिज्ञा की है, वह सब वे हमें देंगे।

ru.L: Утверждающий же нас с вами {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} и помазавший нас — Бог, \v 22 и запечатлевший нас, и давший залог Духа в сердца наши.
ru.B: Это Бог укрепляет нас вместе с вами {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}. Бог помазал нас, \v 22 Бог запечатлел нас как свою собственность и дал нам Духа в сердца как залог.
ru.R: Именно Бог делает и нас, и вас сильными в жизни с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}. Бог избрал нас и дал нам особое дело. \v 22 Бог поставил на нас знак, чтобы показать, что мы принадлежим {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. И Бог дал Духа в наши сердца. Дух — это как первый взнос, обещание, что Бог даст нам и всё остальное, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} обещал.

uk.L: А той, хто утверджує нас разом із вами {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} і помазав нас, — Бог, \v 22 який і запечатав нас, і дав завдаток Духа в наші серця.
uk.B: Саме Бог робить нас непохитними {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}, нас разом із вами. Бог помазав нас, \v 22 і Бог позначив нас печаттю як свою власність і дав нам Духа в наші серця як завдаток.
uk.R: Бог — той, хто зміцнює і нас, і вас у нашому житті з {{christos:Христом|Месією}}. Бог вибрав нас і дав нам особливе завдання. \v 22 Бог поставив на нас знак, щоб показати, що ми належимо {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}. І Бог дав Духа в наші серця. Дух — як перший внесок, обіцянка, що Бог дасть нам усе інше, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} пообіцяв.

ja.L: わたしたちをあなたがたと共に{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}へと堅く立たせ、わたしたちに油を注いでくださった方は、神です。\v 22 この方はまた、わたしたちに証印を押し、わたしたちの心に霊の手付金を与えてくださいました。
ja.B: わたしたちをあなたがたと共に{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}に結ばれた者としてしっかりと立たせてくださるのは、神です。神はわたしたちに油を注ぎ、\v 22 わたしたちをご自分のものとして証印を押し、わたしたちの心に霊を手付金として与えてくださいました。
ja.R: わたしたちとみなさんを、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と共に生きる中で強くしてくださるのは、神です。神はわたしたちを選び、特別な役目を与えてくださいました。\v 22 また、わたしたちがご自分のものであることを示すしるしを、わたしたちにつけてくださいました。そして、わたしたちの心に聖霊を与えてくださいました。聖霊は、いわば最初の支払いのようなものです。神が約束されたほかのすべてのものを、必ず与えてくださるという保証なのです。

decisions.choice: to make firm and secure, as a guarantee makes a contract secure
decisions.reason: βεβαιῶν was used in business for a guarantee that confirms a sale (compare Philippians 1:7). The present participle means God keeps on doing it: he holds both Paul and the Corinthians firm in their union with Christ.

decisions.choice: anointed: set apart by God for his service, as kings, priests and prophets were
alternatives: anointed with oil in a ceremony
decisions.reason: Paul plays on Χριστὸν ("Christ", the Anointed One) and χρίσας ("anointed"). In the Old Testament God anointed kings and prophets for their task (1 Samuel 16:13; Isaiah 61:1). Those joined to the Anointed One share his anointing, which is the gift of the Spirit (compare 1 John 2:20, 27).

decisions.choice: "us" after "with you": all believers, Paul among them
alternatives: Paul and his fellow workers only
decisions.reason: Verse 21 begins with "us with you", so Paul includes the Corinthians. The anointing, sealing and gift of the Spirit could refer to Paul's calling as an apostle, since he is defending his own reliability; but everywhere else Paul speaks of the Spirit as given to every believer (Romans 8:9; Ephesians 1:13).

decisions.choice: sealed: marked as God's own, authentic and protected
decisions.reason: A seal pressed in wax marked a document or goods as belonging to someone and kept them from being tampered with. Paul uses the picture for the Spirit given to believers (Ephesians 1:13; 4:30).

decisions.choice: a down payment: the first installment that guarantees the rest will be paid
alternatives: a pledge returned when the debt is paid
decisions.reason: ἀρραβῶνα is a trade word, borrowed from the Semitic languages, for a deposit that is part of the full price. The Spirit is himself the down payment, the first part of what God will give in full (5:5; Ephesians 1:14).

decisions.choice: God the Father, Christ and the Spirit together in the believer's security
decisions.reason: In two verses Paul names God, Christ and the Spirit, each with a part in making believers secure, as he does again at the end of the letter (13:13).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: down payment
decisions.reason: "Down payment" says that the Spirit is part of what is to come, not just a promise of it; "pledge" can be given back.

decisions.choice: God chose us and gave us a special task; put a mark on us to show that we belong to him; like a first payment, a promise that God will give us everything else
alternatives: anointed us; sealed us; the down payment of the Spirit
decisions.reason: Readable explains the three pictures. "Chose us and gave us a special task" is one way of saying what anointing meant; it may say more than Paul does if he means all believers.

decisions.choice: l’acompte (L, B); un premier versement (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: An "acompte" is the first part of the full sum, which is what the word means (m5): the Spirit is part of what is to come. A "gage" can be given back, and "arrhes" can be forfeited. Readable says it in everyday words, as the English "first payment" does.

decisions.choice: {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal has "in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}"; French cannot say "en Messie", so the preposition goes inside the span, as for "in Christ" throughout the book.

decisions.choice: anticipo (L, B); un primer pago (R)
decisions.reason: As in Ephesians 1:14: "arras" today mostly names wedding coins or a legal deposit, and "garantía" keeps only the promise. "Anticipo" is a part paid now with the rest to follow, the trade picture of the meaning decision; Readable says it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: malipo ya awali (L, B); malipo ya kwanza (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as Ephesians 1:14. "Arabuni" is the borrowed trade word but few readers know it today, and "dhamana" (security) keeps only the guarantee, not the first part of a payment.

decisions.choice: alitutia mafuta
decisions.reason: "Kutia mafuta" is the Swahili phrase for anointing a king, priest or prophet, which is the allusion (meaning decision); "kupaka mafuta" is spreading oil on the skin.

decisions.choice: "tiền đặt cọc" (L), "khoản tiền đặt cọc bảo đảm" (B), "khoản trả trước" (R) for arrabon (also 5:5)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: "down payment" (L, B), "first payment" (R). The Vietnamese Ephesians 1:14 says "Đấng bảo chứng" at Literal, where the Greek relative points to the Spirit; here the Greek says "the down payment of the Spirit", so Literal keeps the payment itself, and Balanced uses the Balanced words of Ephesians.

decisions.choice: "xức dầu" and "đóng ấn" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Ephesians 1:13 ("được đóng ấn"); "xức dầu" keeps the Old Testament picture of anointing for service (m2) and the wordplay with Christ, the Anointed. Readable says what each means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "보증금" (L, B); "첫 지불금" (R), here and in 5:5
decisions.reason: The word of Ephesians 1:14 (L, B) for the down payment; the project's Readable says "first payment".

decisions.choice: "기름을 부으시다" (L, B), "택하셔서 특별한 일을 맡기셨습니다" (R); "인을 치시다" (L, B), "표시를 해 주시다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision hears the play on "Christ", the Anointed One, and "anointed", and describes a seal that marks something as one's own; Literal and Balanced keep both pictures, and Readable says what they mean, as the English does.

decisions.choice: o sinal (L); sinal de pagamento (B); uma primeira parcela (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 5:5). In Brazilian business "sinal" is the down payment that secures a purchase and is part of the price, which is what m5 says the Spirit is; Balanced adds "de pagamento" so that it is not read as a sign (the word "sinal" also translates a different Greek word). "Garantia" and "penhor" are a pledge that can be separate from the price or given back, as the English decision says of "pledge".

decisions.choice: ቀብድ (L, B); የመጀመሪያ ክፍያ (R)
decisions.reason: ቀብድ is the everyday Amharic word for a down payment that binds a sale, exactly the Greek picture; Readable says 'first payment', as the English Readable does. The same words return in 5:5.

decisions.choice: "बयाना" (L, B); "पहली क़िस्त" (R)
decisions.reason: "बयाना" is the everyday Hindi word for the first payment that binds a bargain and is part of the price (meaning decision m5). A pledge ("गिरवी") is given back, so it would say less.

decisions.choice: {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}
decisions.reason: As in Romans, the preposition goes inside each option, because "во" fits only "Христе".

decisions.choice: залог
decisions.reason: "Залог" says that the Spirit guarantees what is to come; Readable explains it as a first payment, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: завдаток (L, B); перший внесок (R)
decisions.reason: "Завдаток" is the business word for a first payment that binds the buyer to pay the rest (m5), the sense of the English "down payment". Also in 5:5.

decisions.choice: "証印を押し" (L, B), "しるしをつけて" (R); "手付金" (L, B), "最初の支払い" (R); "霊" (L, B), "聖霊" (R)
alternatives: "保証" alone for the down payment
decisions.reason: "手付金" is part of the price already paid, as the English "down payment" (book terms; m5); the Spirit is 霊 at L and B and 聖霊 at R, with respect forms, as in 1 Corinthians. Book-wide.

decisions.choice: "選び、特別な役目を与えてくださいました"
decisions.reason: Readable explains anointing as the English Readable does; "役目" keeps "務め" free for diakonia (chapter 3).

source.text: Ἐγὼ δὲ μάρτυρα τὸν θεὸν ἐπικαλοῦμαι ἐπὶ τὴν ἐμὴν ψυχήν, ὅτι φειδόμενος ὑμῶν οὐκέτι ἦλθον εἰς Κόρινθον.

records.literal_gloss: But I [as] witness the God call upon against the my soul, that sparing you no longer I came to Corinth.

en.L: But I call on God [as] witness against my soul that [it was] to spare you [that] I did not come again to Corinth.
en.B: I call on God as witness against my own life if I am not telling the truth: I held back from coming to Corinth again because I wanted to spare you.
en.R: I ask God to be my witness, and to punish me if I am lying. The reason I did not come back to Corinth was that I wanted to spare you pain.

fr.L: Mais moi, j’appelle Dieu à témoin sur mon âme : c’est pour vous épargner que je ne suis plus venu à Corinthe.
fr.B: Je prends Dieu à témoin, et j’en réponds sur ma vie : si je me suis abstenu de revenir à Corinthe, c’est pour vous épargner.
fr.R: Je demande à Dieu d’être mon témoin, et de me punir si je mens. Si je ne suis pas revenu à Corinthe, c’est parce que je voulais vous éviter de la peine.

es.L: Pero yo invoco a Dios como testigo contra mi alma de que [fue] por consideración a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} [que] no volví a Corinto.
es.B: Pongo a Dios por testigo contra mi propia vida, si no digo la verdad: dejé de ir otra vez a Corinto porque quería tener consideración con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Pido a Dios que sea mi testigo y que me castigue si miento. La razón por la que no volví a Corinto fue que quería {{plural_you:evitarles|evitaros}} dolor.

sw.L: Lakini mimi namwita Mungu [awe] shahidi juu ya nafsi yangu, kwamba ni kwa kuwahurumia ndiyo sababu sikuja tena Korintho.
sw.B: Namwita Mungu awe shahidi dhidi ya maisha yangu kama sisemi kweli: sikuja tena Korintho kwa sababu nilitaka kuwahurumia.
sw.R: Namwomba Mungu awe shahidi wangu, na aniadhibu ikiwa ninasema uongo. Sababu ya kutorudi Korintho ni kwamba nilitaka kuwaepushia maumivu.

vi.L: Nhưng tôi kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời làm chứng nghịch lại linh hồn tôi, rằng [chính] vì muốn tránh cho anh chị em mà tôi đã không trở lại Cô-rinh-tô.
vi.B: Tôi xin Đức Chúa Trời làm chứng nghịch lại mạng sống tôi nếu tôi không nói thật: tôi đã không trở lại Cô-rinh-tô là vì muốn tránh cho anh chị em.
vi.R: Tôi xin Đức Chúa Trời làm chứng cho tôi, và trừng phạt tôi nếu tôi nói dối. Tôi đã không trở lại Cô-rinh-tô là vì tôi muốn anh chị em khỏi phải đau buồn.

ko.L: 내가 내 목숨을 걸고 하나님을 증인으로 부릅니다. 내가 여러분을 아끼려고 고린도에 다시 가지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 내가 진실을 말하지 않는다면 내 목숨을 거두셔도 좋다고, 하나님을 증인으로 모십니다. 내가 고린도에 다시 가지 않은 것은 여러분을 아끼려고 그랬던 것입니다.
ko.R: 내가 거짓말을 한다면 하나님께서 나를 벌하셔도 좋습니다. 하나님께서 내 증인이 되어 주시기를 바랍니다. 내가 고린도에 다시 가지 않은 것은 여러분에게 아픔을 주지 않으려고 그랬던 것입니다.

pt.L: Mas eu invoco Deus como testemunha contra a minha alma de que [foi] para poupar vocês [que] não voltei a Corinto.
pt.B: Eu invoco a Deus como testemunha contra a minha própria vida, se não estiver dizendo a verdade: deixei de ir outra vez a Corinto porque queria poupá-los.
pt.R: Peço a Deus que seja a minha testemunha e que me castigue se eu estiver mentindo. Não voltei a Corinto porque eu queria poupar vocês de mais tristeza.

am.L: እኔ ግን ልራራላችሁ ብዬ እንደ ገና ወደ ቆሮንቶስ እንዳልመጣኩ፣ በነፍሴ ላይ እግዚአብሔርን ምስክር አድርጌ እጠራለሁ።
am.B: እውነቱን ባልናገር በሕይወቴ ላይ እንዲፈርድ እግዚአብሔርን ምስክር አድርጌ እጠራለሁ፤ እንደ ገና ወደ ቆሮንቶስ ከመምጣት የተቆጠብኩት ልራራላችሁ ስለ ፈለግኩ ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ምስክሬ እንዲሆን፣ ብዋሽም እንዲቀጣኝ እለምናለሁ። ወደ ቆሮንቶስ ያልተመለስኩት ሥቃይ እንዳይደርስባችሁ ስለ ፈለግኩ ነው።

hi.L: पर मैं परमेश्वर को अपने प्राण पर गवाह ठहराता हूँ, कि तुम्हें बख़्शने के लिए ही मैं फिर कुरिन्थुस नहीं आया।
hi.B: मैं परमेश्वर को गवाह मानकर कहता हूँ, और यदि मैं सच न कहूँ तो वे मेरे प्राण के विरुद्ध गवाही दें: मैं फिर कुरिन्थुस इसलिए नहीं आया क्योंकि मैं तुम्हें बख़्शना चाहता था।
hi.R: मैं परमेश्वर से कहता हूँ कि वे मेरे गवाह हों, और यदि मैं झूठ बोल रहा हूँ तो मुझे दंड दें। मैं कुरिन्थुस वापस इसलिए नहीं आया क्योंकि मैं तुम्हें दुःख से बचाना चाहता था।

ru.L: Я же призываю Бога в свидетели на душу мою, что, щадя вас, я больше не пришёл в Коринф.
ru.B: Я призываю Бога в свидетели против моей собственной жизни, если говорю неправду: я не пришёл снова в Коринф, потому что хотел пощадить вас.
ru.R: Я прошу Бога быть моим свидетелем и наказать меня, если я лгу. Я не вернулся в Коринф потому, что хотел избавить вас от боли.

uk.L: А я кличу Бога у свідки на мою душу, що, щадячи вас, я більше не прийшов до Коринту.
uk.B: Кличу Бога у свідки проти власного життя, якщо я кажу неправду: я утримався від того, щоб знову прийти до Коринту, бо хотів пощадити вас.
uk.R: Я прошу Бога бути моїм свідком і покарати мене, якщо я брешу. Я не повернувся до Коринту тому, що хотів уберегти вас від болю.

ja.L: しかしわたしは、わたしの魂に対する証人として、神を呼び求めます。あなたがたを容赦して、わたしはもうコリントへは行かなかったのです。
ja.B: わたしは自分の命をかけて、神を証人としてお呼びします。もし偽りを言っているなら、神に裁かれてもかまいません。わたしが再びコリントへ行かなかったのは、あなたがたに厳しくしないためでした。
ja.R: わたしは、神に証人になっていただきます。もしわたしがうそをついているなら、神に罰していただいてもかまいません。わたしがコリントに戻らなかったのは、みなさんにつらい思いをさせたくなかったからです。

decisions.choice: a solemn oath: may God judge my life if this is false
alternatives: God, who knows my soul, is my witness
decisions.reason: Calling God as witness is an oath. "Against my soul" most naturally means that Paul stakes his life on what he says. The phrase could also mean that God sees into his soul, but either way he swears that he is telling the truth.

decisions.choice: to spare: to hold back from coming with severe discipline
decisions.reason: φειδόμενος means to treat someone gently, holding back from harsh treatment. In 13:2 Paul warns that next time he will not spare them. Another visit at this point would have meant painful confrontation (2:1).

decisions.choice: the visit Paul did not make
decisions.reason: οὐκέτι ("no longer, not again") points to an earlier, painful visit (2:1; 13:2). Instead of returning, Paul wrote a letter "with many tears" (2:3-4). The decision about the visit, not fickleness, is what changed his plan.

decisions.choice: against my own life if I am not telling the truth (B); to punish me if I am lying (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out what the oath formula means (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: to spare you pain
decisions.reason: Readable says what Paul spared them, as 2:1-3 goes on to explain.

decisions.choice: por consideración a ustedes (L); tener consideración con ustedes (B)
decisions.reason: Spanish "perdonar" would suggest forgiving, and "ahorrar" needs an object. To spare them here means holding back from coming with severe discipline (meaning decision); "tener consideración con" says that restraint without adding a new idea.

decisions.choice: kuwahurumia
decisions.reason: "Kuhurumia" (to have pity on, to spare) says that Paul held back from coming with severe discipline, as Romans 11:21 uses it for God sparing the branches.

decisions.choice: "もし偽りを言っているなら、神に裁かれてもかまいません" (B); "つらい思いをさせたくなかった" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable spell out the oath (m1) and what Paul spared them (m2).

source.text: οὐχ ὅτι κυριεύομεν ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως, ἀλλὰ συνεργοί ἐσμεν τῆς χαρᾶς ὑμῶν, τῇ γὰρ πίστει ἑστήκατε.

records.literal_gloss: Not that we lord over of you the faith, but co-workers we are of the joy of you, for by the faith you stand.

en.L: Not that we are masters over your faith, but we are coworkers of your joy, for in the faith you stand.
en.B: We do not mean that we are masters of your faith. Rather, we work alongside you to bring you joy, because you are standing firm in your faith.
en.R: We are not your bosses, telling you what to believe. We are working together with you so that you can have joy. And you are standing strong in your faith.

fr.L: Non que nous soyons les maîtres de votre foi, mais nous sommes collaborateurs de votre joie, car dans la foi vous tenez debout.
fr.B: Nous ne voulons pas dire que nous sommes les maîtres de votre foi. Nous travaillons plutôt avec vous pour votre joie, car vous tenez ferme dans votre foi.
fr.R: Nous ne sommes pas vos chefs, qui vous disent ce que vous devez croire. Nous travaillons avec vous pour que vous ayez de la joie. Et vous tenez bon dans votre foi.

es.L: No que seamos señores de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe, sino que somos colaboradores de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} gozo, porque en la fe {{plural_you:están|estáis}} firmes.
es.B: No queremos decir que seamos dueños de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe. Al contrario, trabajamos junto con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} alegría, porque {{plural_you:se mantienen|os mantenéis}} firmes en la fe.
es.R: No somos {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} jefes, para {{plural_you:decirles|deciros}} qué creer. Trabajamos junto con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} alegría. Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:se mantienen|os mantenéis}} firmes en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe.

sw.L: Si kwamba tunatawala juu ya imani yenu, bali sisi ni wafanyakazi pamoja nanyi kwa ajili ya furaha yenu, kwa maana katika imani mnasimama.
sw.B: Hatumaanishi kwamba sisi ni mabwana wa imani yenu. Bali tunafanya kazi pamoja nanyi ili mpate furaha, kwa sababu mnasimama imara katika imani yenu.
sw.R: Sisi si wakubwa wenu wa kuwaambia mambo ya kuamini. Tunafanya kazi pamoja nanyi ili mpate furaha. Nanyi mnasimama imara katika imani yenu.

vi.L: Không phải chúng tôi làm chủ đức tin của anh chị em, nhưng chúng tôi là bạn đồng công vì niềm vui của anh chị em, vì anh chị em đứng vững trong đức tin.
vi.B: Chúng tôi không có ý nói rằng chúng tôi làm chủ đức tin của anh chị em. Trái lại, chúng tôi cùng làm việc với anh chị em để đem lại niềm vui cho anh chị em, vì anh chị em đang đứng vững trong đức tin.
vi.R: Chúng tôi không phải là ông chủ của anh chị em, bảo anh chị em phải tin điều gì. Chúng tôi đang cùng làm việc với anh chị em để anh chị em có được niềm vui. Và anh chị em đang đứng vững trong đức tin của mình.

ko.L: 우리가 여러분의 믿음을 주관하려는 것이 아니라, 여러분의 기쁨을 위하여 함께 일하는 사람들입니다. 여러분은 믿음으로 서 있기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 여러분의 믿음을 지배하려는 것이 아닙니다. 오히려 우리는 여러분이 기쁨을 누리도록 여러분과 함께 일하는 사람들입니다. 여러분은 믿음 안에 굳게 서 있기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 우리는 여러분에게 무엇을 믿으라고 명령하는 윗사람이 아닙니다. 우리는 여러분이 기쁨을 누리도록 여러분과 함께 일하는 사람들입니다. 그리고 여러분은 믿음 안에 굳세게 서 있습니다.

pt.L: Não que sejamos senhores da fé de vocês, mas somos cooperadores da alegria de vocês, pois na fé vocês estão firmes.
pt.B: Não queremos dizer que somos senhores da fé de vocês. Pelo contrário, trabalhamos ao lado de vocês para lhes trazer alegria, porque vocês estão firmes na fé.
pt.R: Não somos chefes de vocês, dizendo no que vocês devem acreditar. Estamos trabalhando junto com vocês para que vocês tenham alegria. E vocês estão firmes na fé.

am.L: በእምነታችሁ ላይ እንገዛለን ማለት አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን የደስታችሁ ተባባሪ ሠራተኞች ነን፤ በእምነት ቆማችኋልና።
am.B: በእምነታችሁ ላይ ጌቶች ነን ማለታችን አይደለም፤ ይልቁንም ደስታ እንዲኖራችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር አብረን እንሠራለን፤ በእምነታችሁ ጸንታችሁ ቆማችኋልና።
am.R: ምን ማመን እንዳለባችሁ የምናዝዛችሁ አለቆቻችሁ አይደለንም። ደስታ እንዲኖራችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር አብረን እየሠራን ነው። እናንተም በእምነታችሁ ጸንታችሁ ቆማችኋል።

hi.L: [यह] नहीं कि हम तुम्हारे विश्वास पर स्वामी बनकर अधिकार जताते हैं, पर हम तुम्हारे आनंद के सहकर्मी हैं, क्योंकि विश्वास ही से तुम स्थिर हो।
hi.B: हमारा यह अर्थ नहीं कि हम तुम्हारे विश्वास के स्वामी हैं। बल्कि हम तुम्हारे साथ मिलकर काम करते हैं कि तुम्हें आनंद मिले, क्योंकि तुम अपने विश्वास में दृढ़ खड़े हो।
hi.R: हम तुम्हारे मालिक नहीं हैं जो तुम्हें बताएँ कि तुम्हें क्या विश्वास करना है। हम तुम्हारे साथ मिलकर काम कर रहे हैं, ताकि तुम्हें आनंद मिले। और तुम अपने विश्वास में मज़बूती से खड़े हो।

ru.L: Не потому, что мы господствуем над вашей верой, но мы соработники вашей радости, ведь верой вы стоите.
ru.B: Мы не хотим сказать, что мы хозяева вашей веры. Нет, мы трудимся вместе с вами ради вашей радости, ведь вы твёрдо стоите в вере.
ru.R: Мы не начальники над вами, которые говорят вам, во что верить. Мы трудимся вместе с вами, чтобы у вас была радость. А в вере вы стоите крепко.

uk.L: Не те, щоб ми панували над вашою вірою, але ми співпрацівники вашої радості, бо у вірі ви стоїте.
uk.B: Ми не маємо на увазі, що ми пани над вашою вірою. Навпаки, ми працюємо разом із вами задля вашої радості, бо ви твердо стоїте у вірі.
uk.R: Ми не ваші начальники, які кажуть вам, у що вірити. Ми працюємо разом із вами, щоб ви мали радість. І ви міцно стоїте у вірі.

ja.L: [それは]わたしたちがあなたがたの信仰を支配しているということではありません。わたしたちは、あなたがたの喜びのための同労者なのです。あなたがたは信仰において立っているからです。
ja.B: わたしたちは、あなたがたの信仰を支配する主人だというのではありません。むしろ、あなたがたが喜びを得るように、あなたがたと共に働いているのです。あなたがたは信仰にしっかりと立っているからです。
ja.R: わたしたちは、みなさんに何を信じるべきかを命令するような、上に立つ者ではありません。みなさんが喜べるように、いっしょに働いているのです。それに、みなさんは信仰にしっかりと立っています。

decisions.choice: to rule over as a master
decisions.reason: κυριεύομεν means to be lord or master over something. Paul disclaims any such rule over the Corinthians' faith; the same idea is in 1 Peter 5:3, and in 4:5 Paul calls himself their slave for Jesus' sake.

decisions.choice: a correction of what verse 23 might suggest
decisions.reason: οὐχ ὅτι ("not that") heads off a misunderstanding: talk of sparing them might sound as if Paul controls them. He does not.

decisions.choice: coworkers for your joy: working with you to bring you joy
decisions.reason: συνεργοί is Paul's word for those who work alongside him (Philippians 2:25; Romans 16:3). Here the work aims at their joy, which his visit, had it come then, would have spoiled (2:1-3).

decisions.choice: you stand firm in your faith
alternatives: you stand by means of faith
decisions.reason: The dative πίστει can mean the sphere ("in faith") or the means ("by faith"). Either way, the Corinthians' standing is their own trust in Christ, not Paul's authority over them (compare 1 Corinthians 16:13).

decisions.choice: are masters over (L); are masters of (B)
decisions.reason: "Masters" brings out the link with "lord" and with Paul's language of slaves and masters (4:5).

decisions.choice: We are not your bosses, telling you what to believe
alternatives: we do not rule over your faith
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday word for someone who gives orders, and says what ruling over faith would mean.

decisions.choice: gozo (L); alegría (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Philippians 4:1: Literal keeps the traditional "gozo"; Balanced and Readable use the everyday "alegría".

decisions.choice: "支配している" (L); "支配する主人" (B); "命令する……上に立つ者" (R)
decisions.reason: To rule as a master (m1); Balanced "主人" keeps the link with Paul as their servant in 4:5.
